context.arm_file: validation/division/j1_diagnostic_arms.json (registered at cfe0fa3); its definitions of A1, A6c, A7a and the descriptors D1-D7 are used unchanged
context.single_arm_results: /mnt/workspaces/Cells/cell-division-s0b-20261111-01/j1-diagnostic-01/ (snapshot 556b5eb); PROGRESS.md, S0b J1 diagnostic entry (12 November)
what_they_showed: Only A1 (bath-facing fraction f) moves Em at J1 into the window, at f of about 0.015-0.024 by interpolation. There Em is still falling at J1 and Rm has no late rise.
Only A7a (access scaled with furrow depth) gives a late Rm rise (D7 +64, +130, +224 kOhm at alpha 0.5, 1, 2). Rm2 pins the access at J1, so it leaves Em at J1 at the record's value.

Every calibrated point shares two mismatches with dLB74's description: the Rm fall is front-loaded (D5 0.85-0.94, except A1 from f 0.03 and A2 from half its end), and the Em minimum comes at 7-10 min.

rules.model: R-full only (validation/division/cleft_egg_reference.py). No engine run and nothing in src/.
rules.base: Each arm changes only what it states. Every other input keeps its registered default, including the uniform insertion schedule.
rules.recalibration: Every point: P_old on pulse Rm1 = 852 kOhm and the access A/L (or its scale kappa) on pulse Rm2 = 488 kOhm at J1, as in the arm file. Same pulse protocol and readout.
rules.integrator: LSODA, rtol 1e-10, as the band and the single arms.
rules.null_path: R-full's null path stays bit-identical: no change to cleft_egg_reference.py or cleft_rings_reference.py is needed (see code). If implementation finds otherwise, the extension goes behind a null-default field with a null-reproduction test, and the lead is told before it lands.
rules.held: C1 and J2 stay held: no solution B or C run anywhere and no DFS74 or J2 quantity for any model, tests included.
rules.cytosolic_Na: Reported at J1 beside dL74's measured 22.4 +/- 1.1 mM. Never selected on.
rules.no_value_from_Em: Apart from f's declared calibration (calibration_per_unknown), no parameter value is picked from Em or from the time course. Curves are reported whole.

what_is_left_as_the_test.A1_x_A7a: Rm1, Rm2 and J1 are all used as calibration data. The only test in this round is the 0-35 min shape against the registered p531 criteria (pass_criteria). The out-of-sample test of a frozen candidate is C1, held until a candidate is frozen.
what_is_left_as_the_test.seal_x_A7a and A6c_x_A7a: Neither has a parameter calibrated on J1, so J1's Em (window -21.9 to -18.7 mV) is a test, together with the same shape criteria. These two pairings test whether a level-shifter other than bath-facing new membrane can meet J1 and the shape.
what_is_left_as_the_test.never_tested_here: Cytosolic Na (reported only), C1 and J2 (held).

pass_criteria.route: p531 only. The criteria are dLB74's description (p531, V), converted to numbers below and registered before any run of this round.
why_not_fig2: p531 describes dLB74's series ('often' marks features not seen in every egg). That is the series whose Table I means calibrate R-full. Fig. 2 is one egg, and no spread is given from which to set a tolerance.

Fig. 2's trace was read approximately (F, 400 dpi), and that prose reading was registered at cfe0fa3, before the single-arm runs. Its D-values, however, were first computed after those runs (PROGRESS, 12 November), and no digitisation with an uncertainty exists. Targets and tolerances set from those values now would be chosen with the single-arm results in view.
The p531 statements bear on exactly the features at issue: how Em falls and when it reaches its minimum, how long the Rm fall lasts, and how large the late changes are.
pass_criteria.drafting_disclosure: The drafter knew the single-arm results and the post-run Fig. 2 values while writing these conversions. Each threshold is derived from the p531 wording alone, but the lead should review them with that in mind.
pass_criteria.fig2: Fig. 2's values are reported beside every point and never judged. As a check, the shape criteria (T-D2 to T-D7) admit Fig. 2's egg in its own terms. Its Em at second cleavage, about -17 mV, belongs to one egg and is not compared with T-J1. Approximate post-run values: D2 -10 mV; D3 time 15 min; D4 +2.5 mV; D5 0.46; F17 1.0 (plateau 0.84 MOhm, lowest 0.51 MOhm, reached by 13.5 min); D7 +80 kOhm against a limit of 82.5 kOhm. The D3 and D7 criteria sit at their boundaries. Writing this check led the drafter to state T-R17 and T-D7 relative to the fall to the lowest Rm, which the p531 wording describes, rather than to Rm2 (see drafting_disclosure).

criteria.applies_to: seal_x_A7a, A6c_x_A7a (set by construction for A1_x_A7a)
criteria.criterion: Em at J1 in [-21.9, -18.7] mV (the registered window, mean +/- 2 SE)

criteria.text: 'in the next 10 min it becomes about 10 mV more negative'
criteria.conversion: A stated round value is read as the interval that rounds to it at the next coarser step: 5 mV for 'about 10 mV'.

criteria.text: 'during the second half of cleavage it often shows a small decrease (1-3 mV) preceding the onset of second cleavage'
criteria.criterion: D3 time >= 15.0 min. The value of the minimum is not judged.
criteria.conversion: The Em minimum before J1 is not in the first half of the 30-min cycle.
The stated upper end. There is no lower bound, because 'often' allows the decrease to be absent.

criteria.text: 'Rm is constant initially, drops drastically from 7 till 17 min'
criteria.conversion: The fall must not end before 16 min. The stated end, 17 min, is read to +/- 1 min, and 'ends' is read as 95% complete. An exponential fall from 7 min that is 95% complete at 16 min (time constant 3.0 min) gives D5 = 0.66; a slower or more even fall gives less (uniform over 7-17 min: 0.30).

criteria.criterion: F17 = (Rm1 - Rm(17)) / (Rm1 - Rm_low) >= 0.935. Rm1 is the initial plateau (the calibrated 852 kOhm) and Rm_low the lowest Rm from 0 to J1 inclusive. Without a late rise this is Rm(17 min) <= 512 kOhm.
criteria.conversion: The fall must end by 18 min, read the same way as T-D5. An exponential fall from 7 min that is 95% complete at 18 min (time constant 3.67 min) has done 93.5% of its fall at 17 min.

criteria.text: 'and often shows a small increase before second cleavage'
criteria.criterion: D7 = Rm(J1) - minimum Rm before J1 <= 0.25 (Rm1 - Rm_low). With Rm(J1) at the calibrated 488 kOhm this is D7 <= 121 kOhm.
criteria.conversion: 'Small' is read as at most a quarter of the drastic fall, which runs from the plateau to the lowest Rm. There is no lower bound, because 'often' allows the increase to be absent.

by_construction.all_arms: D1 and the constant Em and Rm before onset both follow the declared insertion onset (7 min, inside the stated 6-8 min). They are excluded.
by_construction.A1_x_A7a: Em at J1 is set by f's calibration and excluded. Rm at J1 (kappa) and Rm1 (P_old) are calibration data in every arm.

pass_criteria.pass_rule: A point passes when every applicable criterion holds at that point. No tolerance is added for numerical error: descriptors are computed from the time course at the registered pulse times, to about 1e-6 of each threshold.
pass_criteria.orientation_only: For orientation only, applying the criteria to the single-arm time courses in j1-diagnostic-01, which are not re-judged: the record fails T-J1, T-D2, T-D3 and T-D5. A1 near its crossing (f 0.02) fails T-D2, T-D5 and T-R17 (F17 0.893). A7a alone fails T-D3, T-D4 and T-D5 at every alpha, plus T-D7 at alpha 1 (D7 130 kOhm against a limit of 123) and at alpha 2. No single-arm point passes every shape criterion.

A7a's depth d(t) follows the total inserted area, as registered; the bath-facing part does not change the slit geometry.

arms.points: alpha in {0, 0.5, 1, 2} (4 points). alpha = 0 gives the seal's time course, which was never computed.

arms.roles: a level-shifter without bath-facing membrane, plus the late Rm rise

shared_mismatch_arm.decision: None is proposed: no cited measurement supports one.
shared_mismatch_arm.front_loaded_Rm_fall: The nearest candidate is the registered back-loaded insertion schedule (0.04 mm2/min for 10 min, then about 0.076; j1_declared_inputs, an in-band member). Its 0.04 mm2/min is a rate dLB74 derived from Rm in treated eggs: without the vitelline membrane (growth lasting 7-10 min) and with it plus CCB (15-17 min) (p536, V). BdL73 reports that eggs cleaving without the vitelline membrane grow new membrane at a reduced rate (p100; page located in the text extraction, not checked on the rendered page). So it does not measure normal eggs' early insertion; normal eggs' schedule is measured only by the total at J1 (BdL73 Table II) and the onset.
shared_mismatch_arm.early_Em_minimum: No source gives a mechanism. The measured slit width range (1.5-2.5 um, BdL73 Figs. 7-8) did not move the minimum in A3. BdL73's furrow depths at about 4 and 8 min (p96) are already used by A7a.
shared_mismatch_arm.other_sources_checked: K83: the outward current over new membrane grows up to 10-fold during the 20 min before second cleavage as more new membrane appears (fertilization envelope removed; Results, p1754-1755 in the text extraction). This reflects continuing insertion, not a schedule.
shared_mismatch_arm.option_for_the_lead: The back-loaded schedule could still be added as A1_x_A7a on that schedule (4 points, about 60 CPU-min), declared as unsupported for normal eggs. It is not in this proposal.

freezing_and_exit.eligible_points: alpha = 0 (the registered access) and alpha = 1 (marked) in each pairing; for A6c_x_A7a, the central fit only.
freezing_and_exit.frozen_candidates: Each eligible point that passes every applicable criterion is frozen as computed: f, kappa, P_old, alpha, the seal or the A6c fit, and all registered inputs. It is written to a candidates file with the run's snapshot and nothing is refit. A pass at alpha 0.5 or 2 only, or at a one-at-a-time fit only, is reported as depending on an unmeasured exponent or on one datum's SE, and freezes nothing.
freezing_and_exit.after_freezing: A C1 registration is drafted from held_check_C1_for_frozen_candidates.would_be (dL74 p9-11; solutions B and C) and registered on main, with its rule, before C1's first run. J2 stays held.
freezing_and_exit.parking: If no eligible point passes, the cleft-model question is parked. R-full with the registered inputs stays the reference, and its J1 failure and the shared shape mismatches are recorded as unexplained. C1 and J2 stay held. Resuming needs new measurements or the user's decision.
freezing_and_exit.no_third_round: Either way, no third diagnostic round is registered.
freezing_and_exit.failures: A point that fails to integrate is recorded as failed and does not pass. It may be rerun once with Radau at rtol 1e-10 (the record's registered integrator), reported as such.
freezing_and_exit.no_crossing: If f has no J1 crossing in [0, f_end] at some alpha, that is reported and no candidate exists at that alpha.

report_per_point.at_j1: As in the arm file: Em and Rm (pulse protocol), the separate chords, A/L or kappa, P_old, the lumen composition and potential, and cytosolic Na. Also f (where calibrated), alpha, the seal or the A6c fit, and Em(0).
report_per_point.time_course: Em at every pulse front edge and Rm at every pulse pair, from 0 to 35 min
report_per_point.descriptors: D1-D7 as defined in the arm file (time_course.descriptors) and Rm(17 min). Each criterion's value and pass or fail is reported, with by-construction items marked. Fig. 2's post-run values are given beside them.
report_per_point.verdict: per eligible point: pass or fail; per round: the frozen candidates, or parking
